# The AEO checklist

Everything that makes an AI assistant able to reach you, read you, trust you and quote you — ordered the way an assistant meets you.

Ordered the way an assistant meets you. Work top to bottom — the first group is the one that makes all the others pointless if you skip it.

> Tick these off in the browser version at `index.html` if you would rather not print it —
> progress saves automatically. Items with an **AI** note have a matching prompt in
> [the prompt library](04-ai-prompt-library.md).

## 🚪 Let the assistants in

If a crawler is blocked you are not ranked low, you are absent. This happens by accident far more often than owners realise.

- [ ] Open yourdomain.com/robots.txt and read it  
  <sub>⏱ 5 min</sub>
- [ ] Allow OAI-SearchBot (ChatGPT), PerplexityBot and ClaudeBot  
  <sub>⏱ 10 min</sub>
- [ ] Decide on Google-Extended — it affects Gemini grounding, not normal Search  
  <sub>⏱ 5 min</sub>
- [ ] Check your CDN or firewall is not challenging those crawlers regardless of robots.txt  
  <sub>⏱ 20 min</sub>
- [ ] Remove any leftover site-wide "Disallow: /" from a staging build  
  <sub>⏱ 10 min</sub>
- [ ] Check no page you care about carries a noindex tag  
  <sub>⏱ 10 min</sub>
- [ ] Confirm your key facts are in the HTML, not drawn in by JavaScript afterwards  
  <sub>⏱ 10 min</sub>

## 📍 Your Google listing

The single biggest source of the facts an assistant repeats about you. Free to fix, and most of it is a fifteen-minute job.

- [ ] Claim and verify your Google Business Profile  
  <sub>⏱ 30 min</sub>
- [ ] Set the most specific accurate primary category  
  <sub>⏱ 15 min  ·  🤖 AI prompt: **Pick the right Google category**</sub>
- [ ] Set correct regular hours  
  <sub>⏱ 10 min</sub>
- [ ] Add special hours for every holiday and closure in the next twelve months  
  <sub>⏱ 30 min</sub>
- [ ] Set your price range  
  <sub>⏱ 5 min</sub>
- [ ] Complete every attribute: seating, service options, parking, payments  
  <sub>⏱ 20 min</sub>
- [ ] Set accessibility attributes honestly  
  <sub>⏱ 10 min</sub>
- [ ] Set dietary attributes — vegetarian, vegan, gluten-free, halal, kosher  
  <sub>⏱ 10 min</sub>
- [ ] Declare whether you take reservations, and add the booking link  
  <sub>⏱ 5 min</sub>
- [ ] Write the 750-character description naming specific dishes  
  <sub>⏱ 20 min  ·  🤖 AI prompt: **Write the 750-character business description**</sub>
- [ ] Point the website field at your own domain, not a delivery app  
  <sub>⏱ 10 min</sub>
- [ ] Upload 20+ real photos across the full shot list  
  <sub>⏱ 1 hour  ·  🤖 AI prompt: **Build your photo shot list**</sub>
- [ ] Seed and answer ten entries in the Q&A section  
  <sub>⏱ 30 min  ·  🤖 AI prompt: **Seed your Google Q&A section**</sub>

## 📖 Make your site readable

Everything an assistant knows from your own site, it has to be able to parse. A menu in a PDF may as well not exist.

- [ ] Rebuild the menu as real HTML text — not a PDF, not an image  
  <sub>⏱ 2 hours  ·  🤖 AI prompt: **Turn a photographed menu into a real web page**</sub>
- [ ] Write a description with ingredients and method for every dish  
  <sub>⏱ 2 hours  ·  🤖 AI prompt: **Write dish descriptions that match how people search**</sub>
- [ ] Tag dishes for vegetarian, vegan, gluten-free and allergens — verified by the kitchen  
  <sub>⏱ 45 min</sub>
- [ ] Put name, address, phone and hours as selectable text in the footer  
  <sub>⏱ 15 min</sub>
- [ ] Build a Visit page with parking, transit, landmarks and accessibility  
  <sub>⏱ 2 hours  ·  🤖 AI prompt: **Research your neighborhood for a location page**</sub>
- [ ] Show prices on the menu page  
  <sub>⏱ 30 min</sub>
- [ ] Update the site the same day the kitchen changes the menu  
  <sub>⏱ ongoing</sub>

## 📋 State what AI will never guess

Assistants do not infer. Anything you leave unsaid becomes "I am not sure", and the diner moves on to a place that said it.

- [ ] State your price range and typical spend per person in text  
  <sub>⏱ 30 min</sub>
- [ ] State your reservation policy and the largest party you seat  
  <sub>⏱ 20 min</sub>
- [ ] State private dining capacity and what it costs  
  <sub>⏱ 20 min</sub>
- [ ] State dietary accommodation specifically — which dishes, how cross-contact is handled  
  <sub>⏱ 30 min</sub>
- [ ] State parking, transit and accessibility in plain text  
  <sub>⏱ 20 min</sub>
- [ ] State kids policy, dress code, noise level and dogs on the patio  
  <sub>⏱ 15 min</sub>
- [ ] State last seating and kitchen close, which differ from posted hours  
  <sub>⏱ 15 min</sub>
- [ ] Ask an AI what it would need to recommend you for six occasions, then fill every gap  
  <sub>⏱ 30 min  ·  🤖 AI prompt: **Find the facts your site is missing**</sub>

## ✍️ Make yourself quotable

Assistants lift self-contained passages, not whole pages. Structure decides whether you get used or skipped.

- [ ] Build a page of 15 to 25 real diner questions  
  <sub>⏱ 2 hours  ·  🤖 AI prompt: **Build the FAQ page that AI assistants quote**</sub>
- [ ] Make each question a heading, phrased the way a diner would ask it  
  <sub>⏱ 30 min</sub>
- [ ] Answer each question completely in the first 40 to 60 words  
  <sub>⏱ 1 hour</sub>
- [ ] Make every answer stand alone without the rest of the page  
  <sub>⏱ 30 min</sub>
- [ ] Rewrite your Visit and About pages answer-first  
  <sub>⏱ 1 hour  ·  🤖 AI prompt: **Rewrite a page in answer-first structure**</sub>
- [ ] Add a plain-text facts block to the homepage  
  <sub>⏱ 20 min</sub>

## 🤝 Be consistent and credible

When sources disagree, assistants hedge or drop you. Consistency is the cheapest trust signal there is.

- [ ] Compare hours, price and offerings across your site, Google, Yelp and Apple, and reconcile every difference  
  <sub>⏱ 45 min</sub>
- [ ] Pick your website as the single source of truth  
  <sub>⏱ 15 min</sub>
- [ ] Ask an AI to list every contradiction it can find about you, then fix each at its source  
  <sub>⏱ 30 min  ·  🤖 AI prompt: **Find and correct what AI gets wrong about you**</sub>
- [ ] Claim Apple Business Connect  
  <sub>⏱ 45 min</sub>
- [ ] Claim Bing Places — it feeds a share of Copilot  
  <sub>⏱ 30 min</sub>
- [ ] Find and report duplicate listings for merging  
  <sub>⏱ 1 hour</sub>
- [ ] Name real people — owner, chef, their background and training  
  <sub>⏱ 1 hour</sub>
- [ ] Pair your name with your city everywhere so you are not confused with a similar name elsewhere  
  <sub>⏱ 20 min</sub>

## ⭐ Reviews, because AI paraphrases them

Ask an assistant whether you are any good and it summarises your reviews. They are your sales copy now, written by strangers.

- [ ] Write the review-ask messages for check drop, receipt email and follow-up  
  <sub>⏱ 30 min  ·  🤖 AI prompt: **Write the review request messages**</sub>
- [ ] Put a Google review QR code on the check presenter  
  <sub>⏱ 30 min</sub>
- [ ] Reply to every review, good and bad  
  <sub>⏱ ongoing  ·  🤖 AI prompt: **Draft a reply to a hard review**</sub>
- [ ] Run a theme analysis on your last 100 reviews  
  <sub>⏱ 1 hour  ·  🤖 AI prompt: **Mine your reviews for what to fix and what to promote**</sub>
- [ ] Fix the operational issue your reviews complain about most  
  <sub>⏱ ongoing</sub>
- [ ] Claim and monitor Yelp and TripAdvisor — assistants read them too  
  <sub>⏱ 30 min</sub>

## 🏷️ Spell it out in code

Schema states your facts in the one format that cannot be misread. This is where AI genuinely writes the code for you.

- [ ] Generate Restaurant JSON-LD for the homepage  
  <sub>⏱ 30 min  ·  🤖 AI prompt: **Generate Restaurant schema markup**</sub>
- [ ] Validate it and fix every error  
  <sub>⏱ 10 min  ·  🤖 AI prompt: **Fix schema validation errors**</sub>
- [ ] Add the validated block to the head of your homepage  
  <sub>⏱ 10 min</sub>
- [ ] Use openingHoursSpecification, not free-text hours  
  <sub>⏱ 20 min</sub>
- [ ] Add Menu and MenuItem schema with prices and dietary tags  
  <sub>⏱ 1 hour</sub>
- [ ] Add FAQPage schema to your questions page  
  <sub>⏱ 30 min</sub>
- [ ] Include a sameAs array listing every profile you own  
  <sub>⏱ 20 min</sub>
- [ ] Confirm you are not marking up your own star rating — it is a policy violation  
  <sub>⏱ 10 min</sub>

## 📣 Get onto the pages AI already cites

Assistants lean on local roundups and aggregators. Getting onto a page they already trust is faster than becoming trusted yourself.

- [ ] Ask an assistant for the best restaurants in your city and note its sources  
  <sub>⏱ 30 min  ·  🤖 AI prompt: **Find the sources AI cites for your city**</sub>
- [ ] Claim and complete your profile on every aggregator in those citations  
  <sub>⏱ 1 hour</sub>
- [ ] Pitch two local publications with an actual story  
  <sub>⏱ 1 hour  ·  🤖 AI prompt: **Draft a pitch to a local food writer**</sub>
- [ ] Enter local awards, restaurant weeks and reader polls  
  <sub>⏱ 30 min</sub>
- [ ] Get onto neighbourhood association and tourism board listings  
  <sub>⏱ 30 min</sub>

## 🔁 Measure it monthly

There is no dashboard for this. You measure it by asking, on a schedule. Thirty minutes a month.

- [ ] Build a fixed set of 15 test questions to reuse every month  
  <sub>⏱ 20 min  ·  🤖 AI prompt: **Build your AI visibility test set**</sub>
- [ ] Ask ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity and Copilot what they know about you  
  <sub>⏱ 20 min  ·  🤖 AI prompt: **Find out what AI already says about you**</sub>
- [ ] Ask each for restaurants like yours and note who it recommends instead  
  <sub>⏱ 20 min  ·  🤖 AI prompt: **See who AI recommends instead of you**</sub>
- [ ] Log mentions, position, fact accuracy and cited sources  
  <sub>⏱ 10 min</sub>
- [ ] Chase every wrong fact back to its source and correct it there  
  <sub>⏱ 15 min</sub>
- [ ] Run the monthly review and pick next month's three priorities  
  <sub>⏱ 15 min  ·  🤖 AI prompt: **Run your monthly 30-minute review**</sub>
